notes:
POC: deploy Redwood Private runtime into customer's AWS account (VPC). Customer wants full control of network/keys; must run in their EKS cluster behind private ALB + internal NLB. Deliverable = Terraform module + Helm chart + runbook.

Requirements summary (from SecOps & infra):
- Data residency: EU latvia (legal insists on EU-only storage for vectors/logs).
- KMS: Bring-your-own-CMK in AWS. Redwood must show KMS key usage flow and minimal IAM perms. Customer prefers HSM-backed key but AWS KMS CMK acceptable.
- Audit logs: all inference request metadata (no raw PII) forwarded to Splunk via CloudWatch; retention policy 7 years for audit logs.
- SSO: SAML SSO with Okta for console; service-to-service uses IAM roles + STS assume-role.
- Network: Private endpoints only, no public internet egress from inference nodes. VPC endpoints required for S3 and ECR.
- Compliance checklist: SOC2 Type II report required before procurement sign-off; ISO27001 will be taken in parallel.

POC execution notes:
- Infra: Terraform module (customer fork) creates EKS nodegroups, subnets, security groups, IAM role for service. We provided example modules and plan.
- Helm: custom values.yaml to wire KMS key ARN and Splunk endpoint; values validated in staging cluster.
- Tests: smoke -> correctness, perf -> throughput/latency, security -> verify no outbound, log streaming, KMS access patterns, secret rotation.
- Perf target: p95 latency < 150ms for chat-lite embeddings path; baseline test achieved p95 ~120ms at 50rps with batching disabled. Need 200rps target for production.

Sign-off criteria (agreed with customer):
1) Security sign-off on architecture diagram + IAM policy.
2) Audit logging verified in Splunk (sampleed events + retention).
3) KMS key usage demo + log proof showing CMK usage.
4) Performance benchmark meeting latency/throughput targets in customer's VPC.
5) Runbook + rollback steps delivered.

Customer quotes / friction: "We can't have any model weights leave our VPC" — SecOps emphasized. Procurement: "Need SOC2 + DPA, then we can lock term sheet."

Next tacticals: deliver final Terraform plan and architecture diagram, schedule security re-review (target 2026-03-12), prepare cost estimate for Dedicated fallback if throughput requires reserved capacity.
